cover_doc.name: Maya Chen
paragraphs: I am applying for the software engineering intern role. I am a computer science student at Arizona State University in Tempe, and I expect to graduate in May 2027. Your posting says coursework or a personal project in Python is welcome. That is the work I can show.

Campus Eats is an ordering page I built for late-night dining. A student places an order in the browser. Python records it, SQL stores it, and the kitchen sees a list of what to prepare. 200 students used it. It is the project I would want a reviewer to read first, because it is the Python work your posting asks about.

Shuttle Map is the other project. I mapped the campus shuttle stops and posted the map for the hall. It is smaller than Campus Eats. It is the same kind of work: a page people in the hall actually opened.

I can start in May 2027, when I graduate. Work authorization is not on my resume, so that question is still open and I have not answered it here. I would like to talk about the ordering page and whether it matches the intern work.
